name: BADM 2234
title: The Entrepreneurial Journey
description: (Also offered as MENT 2234.) Interdisciplinary introduction to entrepreneurship that covers the foundational frameworks and skills involved with managing the creation and growth of new businesses as well as the social structures that shape accessibility of entrepreneurship as a career path. Accordingly, we will address three important areas related to new ventures: The Social Foundations of Entrepreneurship, Business Model Development, and Critical Entrepreneurial Management Skills.
requirement_description: Open only to non-business majors; not open to students who have passed or are currently taking MENT or BADM 3234.
